title: Pocket2D sprite animation (*.animation.json)
description: Sprite animation asset loaded by SpriteAnimationAsset::LoadFile (src/shared/animation/SpriteAnimationAsset.cpp). Every object has exactly the listed fields (event is optional): missing, unknown and duplicate fields are rejected. Not expressible here: the file must be at most 4 MiB with nesting depth at most 16, clip names must be unique, all clips together hold at most 65536 frames, frame row/column must not exceed rows/columns, grid products must fit a 32-bit int, and the image must exist under images/ with exactly columns*tile_width_px by rows*tile_height_px pixels. Label limits are UTF-8 bytes in the loader but characters here.

image.description: Atlas path relative to images/: nonempty, '/' separators only, no NUL, no leading '/', second character not ':', no '..' component.

label.description: 1..128 UTF-8 bytes without NUL (the schema bounds characters).

ticks.description: Fixed 1/60 s ticks the frame is shown.

event.description: Event published when the frame starts.
